howTo: Launch AION 2 — redemption is in-game only (there is no website portal).
Open Settings → Miscellaneous → Account → Enter Coupon.
Paste the code exactly (case-sensitive) and confirm; rewards land in your product inventory.

codes.reward: Odyle Energy (Bound) ×4 · Resurrection Spiritstone (Bound) ×5 · Battle Enhance Scroll (Bound) ×10 — 1 per account
codes.source: Steam Top Sellers #1 celebration; expired Oct 13, 23:00 PDT / Oct 14, 08:00 CEST
